children: Titan Machinery Inc. reported results for the quarter ended 2026, with revenue of $496.38M, a net loss of ($9.15M) and diluted loss per share of ($0.4), reflecting weaker equipment demand versus the prior-year period.
¹ Reported as “Total Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net Loss”. ³ Reported as “Diluted loss Per Share”.
Revenue declined 9.2% for the quarter and 10.7% year-to-date, driven by weaker equipment demand amid sustained lower farm commodity prices.
Channel mix shifted toward higher parts & service revenue and rental growth, which helped boost overall gross margin despite lower equipment sales.
Equipment gross margin improved to 8.5% from 6.6% in the prior year quarter, aided by an improved inventory position and reduced floorplan financing costs.
Geographically, Agriculture and Europe recorded significant revenue declines; Construction and Australia grew, the latter helped by timing, an acquisition and foreign-exchange effects.
Management is monitoring absorption and inventory turnover and expects existing cash, credit and operational actions to address liquidity and seasonal needs.
